What are you saying?
Go there quickly to fix things.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.

examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of

examples.text: Elle me veut pour le casting!
examples.trans: She wants me for the casting!

meanings.en: casting, audition process (for a film or play)

meanings.note: changer de + noun without article: changer d'agent

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!
Tu peux me donner un coup de main?
examples.trans: Can you give me a hand?

meanings.en: a hand, help (un coup de main)

examples.text: Ça va lui briser le cœur.

meanings.en: briser le cœur = to break someone's heart

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth

examples.text: Elle avait déjà pris sa décision.
examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

meanings.note: tu es déjà venu? = have you been here before?

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Il n'y a rien entre nous.

meanings.note: entre toi et moi = between you and me
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

foncer.gloss: to go for it, rush ahead

meanings.en: to rush boldly forward, go for it

examples.trans: It's a great opportunity, go for it!

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
before the noun: le même lifting
as an adverb: même Andréa = even Andréa
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: choisir un prénom = to choose a first name

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu fais à Paris?
examples.trans: What are you doing in Paris?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?

examples.trans: We can catch up on the delay.
I am going to catch up with you.

rattraper.gloss: to catch up on, to make up for

meanings.en: to catch up on, to make up for
meanings.note: rattraper le retard = to catch up on the delay
before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu veux un autographe? — Le tien?
examples.trans: Do you want an autograph? — Yours?

examples.text: C'est mon verre ou le tien?
examples.trans: Is this my glass or yours?

meanings.en: le tien / la tienne / les tiens / les tiennes = yours (informal 'tu')
meanings.note: agrees in gender and number with the thing owned
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Il est tombé dans la rue.

meanings.en: laisser tomber = to drop it, to forget it

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: Je suis tout à fait d'accord.

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
